`sample.pdf` is a two-page selectable-text fixture generated with the repository's `jspdf@4.2.1` dependency. It contains one short network setup sentence on each page and no external or customer data.

The DOCX test builds a minimal OpenXML package in memory with the worker's `fflate@0.8.3` development dependency, so it does not rely on a Word or LibreOffice installation.
